title: Lindblad evolution with subelliptic diffusion
summary: We consider classical/quantum correspondence in Lindblad evolution with jump operators for which the corresponding Fokker--Planck equation is subelliptic. This allows us to consider the physical model proposed by Zurek and Paz, and to extend some of the recent mathematical results of Hernandez, Ranard and Riedel, Galkowski and Zworski, and Li, where the diffusion term in the Fokker-Planck equation was assumed elliptic. We consider the case where the jump operators $\ell_j$ in the Lindbladian are linear functions of $x$, and place an assumption which implies that the Hörmander condition holds…
